audit_scope: stdlib JSON and raw-file hashes only; zero model/checkpoint loads, native executions, searches, updates or evaluations

costs.timing_interpretation: Inclusive subcall timings are not additive; observed complete worker wall is authoritative. Per-row online totals exclude role checkpoint loading and the final study result write.

diagnosis.established: Both final learned policies choose STOP on all 24 online tasks each. Successful search trajectories exist for16/24 TRAIN and12/16 measurement tasks. Every optimizer update changed parameters. No teacher or online search call/time cap or beam pruning occurred.
diagnosis.il_unknown: IL saw non-STOP demonstrations and all32 updates changed weights, yet the final greedy online actor always stopped. The changing minibatch losses do not measure fixed training-set fit. Saved receipts alone cannot separate underfitting, actor score bias, limited goal-action representation, or a loss/action alignment bug; a TRAIN-only review is separate.
diagnosis.rl_inference: Sparse positive returns and increasingly concentrated STOP behavior are the visible training bottleneck: only1/128 positive episode,2/128 goal contacts, last64/64 episodes STOP, final entropy0.00013258. This supports an exploration/credit-assignment limitation but is not proof of a gradient or architecture defect.
diagnosis.runtime: RL native collection replay22.130125s exceeds actual rollout actor-forward inclusive time0.303782s; geometry/provenance replay is a substantial cost. Training/final online result evidence writes and hash checks also cost time. No speed advantage is claimed.

Checkpoint hashes and declared lineage are owned-run evidence, not a separately signed proof of training.
Snapshot fields held_out_execution_admitted=false/training_performed=false in experiment-freeze are prospective factory metadata, not post-run outcomes.
